goal: Make story intake record each story as a bead with acceptance criteria, parented to the intake epic, and add one open checkbox per acceptance in that change's tasks.md. Phases 3 and 4 of sprint-plan are this work, not a deferred boundary. Do not write stories markdown, a stories directory, or a story template. Beads materialization runs at the end of intake without a separate flag. Retarget sprint-to-beads off docs/sprints and stories files onto the current openspec/changes/<change-id>/ plus bd create. Keep the existing phase and materializer detail; replace destinations in place. Keep disable-model-invocation true on sprint-plan. Check the four implementation boxes in the beads change tasks.md. Leave the living-spec fold box open. Do not edit the living spec. Do not fold. Do not change the ACTIVE BUILD banner. Do not edit prd, vision, retro, sprint-exec, or sprint-from-beads.

anchors.invariant: A story is a bead plus a tasks.md checkbox. No stories directory. Materialization is not a separate flag.
Phase 3 is still a deferred handoff. Replace that with bead creation.
Materializer still reads docs/sprints stories files. Point it at the change directory.

acceptance.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re,sys; roots=[Path("plugins/morphist-tools/skills/sprint-plan"),Path("plugins/morphist-tools/skills/sprint-to-beads")]; bad=re.compile(r"stories/\*\.md|stories/\{|SPEC_DIR/stories|docs/sprints/"); ok=re.compile(r"not |never |forbid|do not|shall not|must not|does not", re.I); text=(roots[0]/"SKILL.md").read_text(); assert "disable-model-invocation: true" in text; assert "sprint-to-beads" in text; hits=[f"{p}:{i}:{line}" for root in roots for p in root.rglob("*.md") for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1) if bad.search(line) and not ok.search(line)]; sys.exit(chr(10).join(hits)) if hits else print("ok")'
